svg.title: LLMSlim: the context layer for production AI agents
svg.desc: Open source Python library. pip install llmslim. 62x lower cost per question on LongMemEval, 3x fewer tokens at the same LongBench score, +9.7 points over LLMLingua-2.

g.text: Compress, plan and budget what the model sees, from
prompts and chat history to RAG chunks and tool schemas.
It runs inside your own process: no API key, no network call,
678 TESTS · 90% BRANCH COVERAGE · LANGCHAIN, LLAMAINDEX, HAYSTACK, MCP
